**Research methods:**
- Check Google Reviews and Healthgrades for highly-rated orthodontists
- Ask your dentist for referrals
- Look for board certification (American Board of Orthodontics)
- Check if they offer both traditional braces and Invisalign
- Read patient reviews specifically mentioning their experience with your preferred treatment

**What to consider:**
- Experience with your specific needs
- Technology/equipment they use
- Treatment cost and payment plans
- Convenience of location and hours
- Consultation availability (many offer free initial consultations)

- Midtown/Plaza area
- Westport
- Lee's Summit
